en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays; Saudel 380 km east at 11pm
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated about 380 kilometres east of Hong Kong at 11pm and is forecast to linger over the northeastern South China Sea on Thursday morning before turning westwards.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 remained in force on Wednesday night. At 11pm, Tropical Storm Saudel was centred near 22.8 degrees north, 117.8 degrees east, about 380 kilometres east of Hong Kong, and was slow-moving while lingering over the northeastern part of the South China Sea.

Saudel is expected to remain over the northeastern South China Sea on Thursday morning and then gradually turn westwards, skirting the coast of eastern Guangdong. Under the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, local winds are occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. The signal is expected to remain in force on Thursday morning.

The Observatory said Saudel is expected to edge closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary again on Friday, though there are rather large uncertainties in its intensity by then. It will closely monitor the system and assess the need to issue the Strong Wind Signal No. 3 when it edges closer to the estuary. The public should continue to pay attention to the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾晚上11時位於本港以東約380公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾晚上11時位於本港以東約380公里，預料周四早上在南海東北部徘徊，其後逐漸轉西掠過廣東東部沿岸。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號周三晚繼續生效。晚上11時，熱帶風暴沙德爾集結在北緯22.8度、東經117.8度附近，即香港以東約380公里，預料移動緩慢，在南海東北部徘徊。
沙德爾會在周四早上於南海東北部徘徊，並逐漸轉向偏西方向移動，其後掠過廣東東部沿岸。受沙德爾與東北季候風的共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。一號戒備信號會在周四早上維持。
天文台指，預料沙德爾會在周五再度靠近珠江口一帶，但屆時其強度存在相當大變數。天文台會密切監察沙德爾的動向，評估是否需要在其接近珠江口時改發三號強風信號。市民應繼續留意最新天氣消息。
